thread:
Aisha K.: folks — seeing a sharp spike in 503/500s on hosted inference starting ~2024-09-12T10:12Z. Customers reporting timeouts and retries. Initial look: upstream inference worker in pool hosted-rt-eu-west-1a crashed repeatedly; container restart loop and SIGSEGVs in the process.

oncall-bot: ALERT: hosted-infer-prod error-rate > 8% (5m avg). Incident link: https://alerts.internal/r/hosted-infer/8923456789 :rotating_light:

Marta S.: CS is getting slack threads from 2 paying customers, high p95 latency + 503s, they're asking for ETA and whether credits/waiver needed. Can we confirm impact window?

Ravi P.: I'm on it. Which model/pool? Any recent runtime or kernel changes?

Aisha K.: Model variant: rwd-open-13B-q4_0 (quantized), traffic shifted due to autoscaler ~10:00Z. No customer-initiated deploys; infra side rolled a small runtime tweak ~08:40Z but that was staging->canary only (will double-check).

Ben L.: grabbing logs from the node. Saw repeated messages in dmesg: 
```
[  123.456789] infer_runner[31245]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f9d1a2b3c4d sp 00007ffc9d7b1c20 error 4 in libattn.so[7f9d19f00000+1f0000]
[  124.001234] Out of memory: Killed process 31245 (infer_runner) total-vm:13500000kB
```
Also NVML shows sudden mem spike before crash.

Ravi P.: can you paste the short backtrace / stack snippet from the coredump? Also note PID/time so we can correlate with metrics.

Ben L.: paste below (trimmed):
```
#0  0x00007f9d1a2b3c4d in attention::forward(attn_params) +0x2d
#1  0x00007f9d1a6b7f90 in runtime::run_step() +0x1a4
#2  0x00007f9d1a6b9a12 in worker::handle_request() +0x88
#3  0x0000561c4b2f9f07 in start_thread
#4  0x00007f9d1b0d0f23 in clone
```
Segfault looks like attention kernel.

Aisha K.: error-rate timeline: 10:12Z spike to 12% 503s, autoscaler attempted retries which amplified load -> more OOMs. We started fallback routing at 10:25Z to reduce customer impact but several requests already failed.

Marta S.: customers want a timeline AND whether they will be refunded. Please post next steps so I can respond.

Ravi P.: immediate mitigation plan:
- disable KV prefetch for hosted-rt-eu-west-1a (kvcache prefetching seems to increase memory pressure)
- reduce max batch size to 1 for that pool
- route heavy traffic to dedicated capacity or cold fallback model (rwd-open-13B-q4_1)
- roll back the canary runtime tweak if it's active in that pool

Aisha K.: executing kvcache toggle now. Command: `kubectl patch cm hosted-rt-eu-west-1a-config -p '{"data":{"kvcache_prefetch":"false"}}'`

Ben L.: running gcore on the process a few times then uploading to s3: s3://internal-dumps/8923456789/31245.core.gz. Also collected `nvidia-smi dmon` during the spike.

Dan R.: I'll take the ownership for next-level debug and repro. Assigning to eng-runtime. My initial hypothesis: a memory regression in attention kernel combined with prefetch expansion during retries -> transient mem balloon -> GPU OOM -> segfault. Repro plan:
1) run replay load against hosted-rt-eu-west-1a with same request size distribution (many retries + long contexts)
2) enable debug build of libattn with ASAN on a dev node to see mem issues
3) run stress harness with varying batch sizes and kvcache on/off

Ravi P.: rolled back canary runtime on that pool at 10:45Z. Error rate downtrend started ~10:52Z.

Aisha K.: traffic & error metrics: before mitigation 5m error-rate=12%, after kvcache toggle+rollback 5m error-rate=1.6% and customer-facing 503s dropped to near baseline by 11:05Z.

Marta S.: thanks — I'll tell CS to inform customers that mitigations are in place; they asked for impact window and whether we will proactively refund for errors. Suggest credit for incidents >5m of >5% error-rate?

Dan R.: agree to open a postmortem. I'll reproduce and try to pin exact commit in libattn or runtime that regressed. If repro succeeds, plan: patch attention kernel to bound memory during prefetch or make prefetch opportunistic.

Ravi P.: checklist for follow-up (assigned to Dan + Ben):
- reproduce locally with stress harness (Dan)
- run sanitized ASAN debug run (Ben)
- correlate crash times with autoscaler/retry logs (Aisha)
- capture exact request that triggered OOM (if available) and sample prompt (Marta to request from CS)
- prepare postmortem draft and impact calc (customer request count, minutes of 503s, tokens failed)

Ben L.: uploaded additional logs: https://logs.internal/hosted/8923456789 (contains dmesg, journalctl, nvidia-smi snapshot, runner stdout).

oncall-bot: NOTE: Incident ticket created INC-2024-89234, severity P1 -> linked to this thread.

Marta S.: I've told customers we're investigating, applied temporary credits manually for 3 impacted customers who asked, will wait for postmortem for broader policy.

Aisha K.: final note: watch out for similar patterns in other pools; I've added an automated alert rule: if segfaults in libattn > 3 in 5m then escalate.

Dan R.: thanks team — I'll post initial repro status by EOD and start the postmortem.

Marta S.: thanks — keep CS looped and ping me when postmortem link is ready. :thumbsup:
